title: The Last Session
description: Your therapist died last night. Her final patient — you — was the last to see her alive. Now her colleague is asking questions, and your memories of that session keep changing.

meta.disclaimer: This is a work of fiction exploring psychological themes. All characters and events are invented.

setting.location: A private therapy practice in a mid-century office building
setting.atmosphere: Quiet, clinical, disquieting — the smell of coffee and something wrong

win_text_rule: Convince Dr. Hale's colleague that you are innocent — or confess what you actually remember from the last session.

characters.name: Dr. James Cole
characters.motive: Finding out what happened to his colleague before the police arrive
characters.tells: His questions get more precise when you contradict yourself

character_self_knowledge: You are Dr. Hale's colleague and you found her body this morning.
You have read her session notes from last night — but the last entry is missing.
You suspect the patient knows more than they are saying.

canonical_facts.content: Dr. Hale was found dead in her office at 7:30 AM. Cause of death: undetermined.
The session notes from Dr. Hale's 9 PM appointment are missing from the system.
